vb5.act: Buy to need and wait for lower offers.
vb5.why: D-calpan keeps edging down on ample supply.

soy_oil.act: Buy only for formulas that need it; keep inclusion tight.
soy_oil.why: CBOT soybean oil held support near 64.65 c/lb on biofuel demand. At Rs65 maize and Rs135 SBM its energy is worth about Rs125/kg, so oil is a pellet-quality and energy-density buy, not a cheap energy buy.

pbm.act: Quote against SBM value; insist on a certificate per lot.
pbm.why: No public price. Quality varies widely by renderer.

rice_bran.act: Buy with the polish order; specify FFA and acid-insoluble ash.

urea2.act: Same as the other urea item: buy 30–45 days at Rs4,917 a bag or below and press for cash discounts.
urea2.why: Same material as the other urea item: PBS shows Sona urea unchanged at Rs4,917 a bag (Rs98.3/kg) in the week to 19 Nov, 12.8% above a year ago.

wheat_bran.act: Cover winter wanda needs for 30–45 days now with quotes from two flour mills; flour is rising faster than wheat, so mills will push bran prices up next.
wheat_bran.why: AMIS Punjab wheat median reached Rs126.9/kg on 20 Nov (12 mandis), 21% above 1 Sep, and PBS shows flour up 4.42% to Rs3,100.19 per 20 kg bag in the week to 19 Nov after +0.94% the week before. The new-crop support price of Rs112.5/kg is below mandi rates, and bran tightens through winter until the April harvest.

salino.act: Keep ionophores off the wanda line.
salino.why: Use in a shuttle or rotation programme to slow resistance.

enramycin.act: Plan an AGP-free programme (enzymes, butyrate, toxin control).
enramycin.why: An antibiotic growth promoter; the EU banned growth-promoter use in 2006.

phytase.act: Keep the full matrix value in formulation.
phytase.why: With MCP firm, phytase at full matrix saves phosphorus cost.

marble2.act: Buy on spec (Ca and particle size).

maxiban.act: Keep ionophores off the wanda line.
maxiban.why: Use in a shuttle or rotation programme to slow resistance.

madura.act: Keep ionophores off the wanda line.
madura.why: Use in a shuttle or rotation programme to slow resistance.

lys_sulph.act: Buy to need; ask suppliers to match China FOB.
lys_sulph.why: Lysine is stable FOB China with a quiet outlook as producers cut output.

rsm_midpro.act: Use the same supplier comparison as Rape Seed Meal.
rsm_midpro.why: Same material as Rape Seed Meal.

rice_polish.act: Collect three quotes this week and buy stabilised polish with an FFA and sand limit in the contract.
rice_polish.why: The new rice crop is being milled (Oct–Jan), the season of peak polish supply. AMIS IRRI rice is flat at Rs106/kg.

sbm_hipro.act: Lock Dec–Jan needs this week with at least two crushers holding bean stocks before they reprice to the $341 CBOT level; a licence lapse at end-November would tighten local supply further.
sbm_hipro.why: CBOT Dec meal closed $341.00/st on 20 Nov, up $8.70 on the day and $11.20 on the week, its highest close this month and 6% above 9 Nov ($320.70), even as corn hit a four-month low. Pakistan still buys meal from local crushers only: import approvals were deferred on 23 Oct and current GM soybean licences run only through November 2026, with no renewal found as of 21 Nov.

pot_carb.act: Buy to the current run only.

mcp.act: Keep phytase at full matrix to cut MCP; buy monthly.
mcp.why: Imported phosphate. DAP is firm at Rs17,128 a bag (PBS, 8 Oct), so phosphorus is not cheap.

thr.act: Lock Q1 volume now at current prices.
thr.why: Chinese suppliers raised threonine slightly; ample stocks limit the upside.

rs_cake.act: Buy only what the current wanda run needs; test cottonseed cake in the dairy formula.
rs_cake.why: Cottonseed cake (AMIS) fell from Rs118.4 to Rs98.6/kg since 1 Sep, a cheaper wanda protein on most offers.

dlmet.act: Keep normal cover; no need to chase.
dlmet.why: Prices have stabilised with slight upward pressure in China; buyers are covered into Q1.

pkc.act: Get CFR Karachi offers and landed costs on the Import tab.
pkc.why: Imported; the rupee is steady at Rs276.75, so there is no currency reason to rush.

vb3.why: Niacin has stabilised after falling, and some Chinese suppliers have withdrawn offers or announced increases.

molasses.act: Hold 2–3 weeks of cover and top up only from existing stock; this week ask Okara-belt mills and two traders for fresh-crush start dates and quotes, and book the first lot when at least two nearby mills are crushing.
molasses.why: The ECC has now approved another 400,000 t of sugar exports (21 Nov), taking the total to 600,000 t, which the industry had demanded before starting the Punjab crush; most mills had not crushed by 18 Nov and PSMA says the law allows a start as late as 30 Nov. Cane area is up 16% to 2.452 million acres, so fresh molasses should be ample once mills run.

bypass_fat.act: Get quotes for the dairy line.

rsm.act: Price per kg of protein against canola meal and cottonseed cake before buying.
rsm.why: Local rapeseed meal supply follows the 552,000 t rapeseed crop and imported seed. Cottonseed cake has fallen 16.8% since September, which caps rapeseed products in wanda.

gly.act: Get two quotes before the next order.

mbm.act: Quote and compare per kg of protein and phosphorus.
mbm.why: No public price. Poultry use only.

colistin.act: Stop routine feed use; keep only vet-prescribed treatment and check DRAP status.
colistin.why: WHO lists colistin as a highest-priority critically important antimicrobial. India banned it for food animals in 2019.

gatawa.act: Confirm what Gatawa is and its supplier.

avilamycin.act: Plan an AGP-free programme (enzymes, butyrate, toxin control).
avilamycin.why: An antibiotic growth promoter; the EU banned growth-promoter use in 2006.

vit_premix.act: Ask premix suppliers to reprice on current vitamin costs and fix the price for 3–6 months.
vit_premix.why: Vitamin A is at an all-time low, E is weak, D3 is easing and B5 is edging down.

canola_meal.act: Raise canola meal toward its inclusion limit in grower and finisher diets; buy where the offer is below its value against SBM.
canola_meal.why: The cheapest hedge against a soybean-licence lapse: GE canola has market access and imports are forecast at 750,000 t for MY2026/27.

urea1.act: Buy the next 30–45 days for the wanda line at Rs4,917 a bag or below; the new price has settled, so press dealers for cash discounts rather than waiting for a fall.
urea1.why: PBS shows Sona urea unchanged at Rs4,917 a bag (Rs98.3/kg) in the week to 19 Nov, after a 1.55% rise the week before; it is 12.8% above a year ago (Rs4,358) following the Engro and FFC increases of 6–7 Nov during rabi sowing.

toxin_binder.act: Stock 60 days and raise the dose when maize tests high.
toxin_binder.why: New-crop maize and winter storage raise the aflatoxin load.

diclazuril.act: Keep ionophores off the wanda line.
diclazuril.why: Use in a shuttle or rotation programme to slow resistance.

maize.act: Keep buying dry new-crop in weekly lots, starting with Sahiwal (Rs46.5/kg for a second report, check moisture on such a low price), then Pakpattan (Rs63.5/kg), Vehari (Rs63.8/kg) and Mailsi (Rs64.4/kg); Okara is Rs74.8/kg. Reject lots above 14% moisture or failing aflatoxin.
maize.why: The belt median firmed 0.5% to Rs64.4/kg on 22 Nov (seven mandis) from Rs64.1/kg on 20 Nov; it is 0.7% above 23 Oct (Rs63.9/kg), 15.6% below a year ago (Rs76.3/kg on 23 Nov 2025) and at 36% of its 52-week range (Rs54.4–82.5/kg). Other Punjab mandis sit at Rs76.3/kg, so the belt stays the cheapest source as autumn-crop arrivals peak in Nov–Dec.

maize_oilcake.act: Quote against its value on the Value tab.
maize_oilcake.why: Priced off maize, which is soft into the harvest.

sbm_lp.act: Buy LP only when it is at least Rs12/kg under HiPro; otherwise buy HiPro.
sbm_lp.why: Same licence risk as HiPro. At Rs135/kg HiPro and Rs65/kg maize, 44% meal is worth about Rs122.7/kg on energy and protein (see Value).

furazolidone.act: Stop buying; remove from formulas and check DRAP status.
furazolidone.why: A nitrofuran: barred in food animals by the EU and US. Pakistan decided to ban nitrofuran imports in 2007.

marble0.act: Buy on spec (Ca and particle size).

dvm_premix.why: Same vitamin moves as the poultry premix.

soy_hull.act: Keep a 30-day stock for the wanda line.
soy_hull.why: Supply follows the soybean crush, so a licence lapse would also tighten hulls.

gluten60.act: Get three quotes; buy only below its value price.
gluten60.why: Priced by wet millers off maize, which is soft. Worth about Rs181/kg against Rs65 maize and Rs135 SBM on energy and protein alone, before pigment value.

marble.act: Buy on spec (Ca and particle size).

soda_bicarb.act: Buy to the current run only.

ile.act: Get two quotes before the next order.

gluten30.act: Collect quotes from two millers this week.
gluten30.why: No public price. Value against maize and SBM is shown on the Value tab.

arg.act: Get two quotes before the next order.

bone_meal.act: Buy only if cheaper per kg of P than MCP.
bone_meal.why: A phosphorus source: price per kg of P against MCP.
